# Across all Modules

## Access

### GEN-03 — Own login per role

Statement: Sales execs, the sales head and accounts staff each log in with their own access; accounts staff do the credit checks. [CE-1, WS-1]
Acceptance:
- A sales exec, the sales head and an accounts clerk each log in and see only what their role allows. (proposed, to confirm)
Priority: TBC
Scope: Open
Sources: CE-1, WS-1
Proposed: yes

### GEN-04 — Buyers' phone numbers only for their own sales exec

Statement: A sales exec cannot see the phone numbers of buyers handled by other sales execs. [WS-2]
Acceptance:
- Exec A opens an enquiry or quotation of exec B's buyer and sees no phone number. (proposed, to confirm)
Priority: TBC
Scope: Open
Sources: WS-2
Proposed: yes

## Localisation

N/A: One currency (Indian rupees), English only. [WS-1]

## Hosting

### GEN-05 — Neome cloud, no single sign-on

Statement: The system runs on Neome cloud, with no single sign-on. [QA-1]
Acceptance:
- Users log in to Neome cloud with their Neome login; no single sign-on is set up. (proposed, to confirm)
Priority: TBC
Scope: Neome
Sources: QA-1
OIs: OI-07
Proposed: yes

## Migration

### GEN-01 — Move the customer list from Excel

Statement: The old customer list in the Excel sheet is moved into the new system: the current customer Excel sheet, all its columns, loaded with Neome's Excel import. [CE-2, QA-1]
Acceptance:
- Every customer row of the agreed Excel sheet is in the new system after migration. (proposed, to confirm)
Priority: TBC
Scope: Open
Sources: CE-2, QA-1
OIs: OI-05
Proposed: yes

## Training

### GEN-02 — Train staff before go-live

Statement: Sales execs and both accounts staff are trained before go-live; Neome trains the sales head, who then runs the training. [CE-1, QA-1]
Acceptance:
- Every sales exec and accounts staff member has done the training before go-live. (proposed, to confirm)
Priority: TBC
Scope: Open
Sources: CE-1, QA-1
OIs: OI-06
Proposed: yes
